run_gen_static_metadata: run the script to generate gRPC static metadata C++ header and source files
run_gen_static_metadata_header: run the script with the header flag to output the static metadata header to stdout
run_gen_static_metadata_source: run the script with the source flag to output the static metadata source to stdout
run_gen_static_metadata_dictionary: run the script with the dictionary flag to output the HPACK fuzzing dictionary to stdout
review_mangle: review the mangle function that converts metadata names into valid C identifier strings
